name: Silent / no-grant KMS policy is UNKNOWN, not safe
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 127. A Deny-only KMS key policy has no positive grant and no account-delegation statement. Coverage stays INCOMPLETE and the KMS-SILENT-POLICY-UNKNOWN finding surfaces the inversion: a KMS key with no account-delegation Allow is UNKNOWN for effective access (IAM identity policies cannot govern the key). The absence of a positive finding does NOT mean the key is safe or unreachable - a clean, empty analysis is never presented as 'safe'.

KMS-SILENT-POLICY-UNKNOWN: does NOT mean the key is safe
